description: Price history for a symbol from BCA's hourly price snapshots (USD price, market cap, 24h volume and change), up to 365 days: hourly up to 30 days and daily averages beyond, unless granularity says otherwise. Partial when days in the window have no snapshot, stale when the newest snapshot is over 3 hours old, unseeded when the window is empty.

granularity.description: hourly or daily. Default: hourly up to 30 days, daily averages for longer windows.

name: get_history_prices
